Term1: Persistent or recurrent urethritis or cervicitis
Text:
# PERSISTENT OR RECURRENT URETHRITIS OR CERVICITIS

Retreat with initial treatment regimen if patient was non-compliant with initial treatment regimen or re-exposed to an untreated sex partner. If infection is not due to non-compliance with treatment regimen or re-exposure to an untreated sex partner, infection is most commonly caused by M. genitalium and less commonly T.
vaginalis.

Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment for persistent or recurrent urethritis and failure of initial doxycycline treatment

Metronidazole 2 gm PO ONCE ($) [DI] Azithromycin 1 gm PO ONCE ($) [M]

### Failure of above treatment

Consult Infectious Diseases (inpatient)

## Outpatient

### Treatment for persistent or recurrent urethritis and failure of initial doxycycline treatment

Metronidazole 2 gm PO x 1 dose ($) [DI] Azithromycin 1 gm PO x 1 dose ($)
[M]

### Failure of above treatment

Consult Infectious Diseases (outpatient)
